_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 1: It, the last boss ($82B5-$8501). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): first frame?
regions.description: Entered from the bank 6 stub `$9605`. Type bit 7 set (already initialised) goes to the per-frame code at `$82F8`. Table stats: flags `$5A` (Eraser-immune, the big burst), hit points `$88` = 136, attack `$20` = 32, death type 7 (the 42-frame explosion), art block `$45`; no area scaling.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): art and hit points
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8` (the art wait: until block `$45` is loaded, otherwise this call returns for the caller) and `JSR $C165` (`$D385`): **the hit points are widened to 16 x the table: 136 x 16 = 2,176**, held as `$0590` (low byte, 128) and `$0740` (high byte, 8).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): picture
regions.description: Metasprite `$0548` := `$51` (the body, drawn twice, mirrored, 17 sprites a side).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): count/attribute
IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): place and targets
regions.description: x `$0530` := `$80` and its spring target `$0680` := `$80`; y `$0518` := `$30` (a position given by the spawner is ignored).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): y target
IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): x speed
regions.description: `$0608` := 2 (an initial x kick).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): entrance timer
IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): arms
regions.description: Both arm extensions `$07B8` and `$07D0` := `$40`; the arm timer `$0650` := 1.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): state
regions.description: `$07A0` := `$81`: bit 7 = the entrance, bit 0 = still.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): mirror flicker
regions.description: `$0560` bit 6 is flipped **every frame** (the body is drawn mirrored on alternate frames; the picture is symmetric, so what this does to the sprites is a shimmer at most: not established).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): entrance
regions.description: State bit 7: `DEC $0788`; at 0 go to `$8315`; otherwise only the odd values continue to `$8349` (the body is drawn on every second frame: a flicker), the even return. RUN: 180 frames.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): the entrance ends
IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): palette from the hit points
regions.description: `$0740` under 2 (fewer than 512 hit points) is stored in `$0560` as the palette (0, or 1 under 512): the boss changes colour as it is hurt. RUN: palette 1 for 256-511, 0 under 256, 2 above.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): move and stop phases
regions.description: `DEC $0788`; at 0 a new phase: **timer := (random / 2) + `$60` + carry = 96-224 frames, `$07A0` ^= 1; if it is now the still phase the timer is shifted right twice (24-56 frames)**. RUN: still phases of 24-56 and moving phases of up to 223.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): still or moving
regions.description: Bit 0 of `$07A0` set: draw only (`$C090`); clear: **the y spring (`$C09C`, acceleration 16/256) toward `$0668` = 64 and the x spring (`$C09F`, 8/256) toward `$0680` = 128**, then `$C08D` (move and draw). Constant-acceleration springs swing bang-bang, so it sweeps about (128, 64). RUN: x 63-191, y 48-80.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): the arms: a new move
regions.description: Not during the entrance. `DEC $0650`; at 0 the counter becomes (random AND `$3F`) + `$10` + carry = 16-80 frames and its low nibble indexes the 16 bytes at `$8430` into `$0638`: **the low three bits of each nibble are one arm's move code** (see the table).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): arm 1 step
regions.description: `$0638 AND 7` and the extension `$07B8` through `$8440`.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): arm 2 step
regions.description: `$0638 >> 4 AND 7` and `$07D0` the same way.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): draw the arms
regions.description: `$86` (the sprite flip register the drawers read) is cut to its palette bits; **the left arm is drawn at dx `$E4` (-28) with extension `$07B8` by `$8457`; `$86` then gets bit 6 flipped and the right arm is drawn at dx `$1C` (+28) with `$07D0`**. RUN: the left shaft at x - 28, the right at x + 28.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): no fire in the entrance
regions.description: State bit 7 returns.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): fire rate by the hit points
regions.description: Y := `$0F`, `$1F` or `$3F` by `$0740` (0, 1, 2 or more) and the shot comes when `$41 AND Y` = 0: **every 16, 32 or 64 frames - fewer than 256 hit points, 256-511, 512 or more**. RUN: gaps of 16 / 32 / 64 frames, the first at frame 191.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): shot 1: a homing bullet
regions.description: A free slot (`$C108`); type `$27` made there at the boss's x and y (`$C105`), **kind `$07A0` := 2** (palette 3, speed class 6, re-aim every 8 frames, turn step 1, 24 hit points, attack 48, art block `$36`) and heading `$0788` := 4 (down).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): shot 2: a lobbed fragment
regions.description: A second slot: type `$2A`, x speed `$0788` := (random AND 3) - 2 (+ carry: -2 to +2), palette = the boss's `$0788` AND 3, `$0728` and `$07B8` := `$18` (the fragment's own art variant, as the cannons use), metasprite `$37`.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): the arms' hit tests
regions.description: `JSR $84CA` for the left arm (dx `$E0` = -32, dy `$07B8`) and the right (dx `$20`, dy `$07D0`).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): the body
regions.description: `JSR $C0C6` (hit test as an ordinary enemy, mask `$30`) and `JMP $C0D8` (the boss rules). RUN: a shot on the body took the boss's hit points down (124 -> 122).

regions.name: IT: the arms' move codes (16 bytes)
regions.description: `77 02 74 20 33 21 34 15 72 42 31 24 01 36 12 34`, indexed by the arm timer's low nibble; the low three bits of the low nibble steer the left arm, of the high nibble the right one (code 3 holds, 0-2 pull in, 4-7 push out).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): one arm step (`$8440`)
regions.description: A = the move code, Y = the extension: **the new extension = Y + code - 3, kept between `$30` and `$70`** (48-112): code 3 holds, 0-2 pull the arm in by 3, 2, 1, 4-7 push it out by 1-4 a frame.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): draw an arm: where the tip is (`$8457`)
regions.description: A = dx, Y = the extension. The tip is at x + dx and y + the extension.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): tip tiles
regions.description: The tile base `$87` := the object's `$06C8`.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): the tip leans in
regions.description: `(extension - $30) / 4` is added to the tip's x for the left arm (+4 step) and subtracted for the right (-4 step); the step is kept in `$15`. **The arms bend inwards as they lengthen.**

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): the tip
regions.description: `LDA #$52 / JSR $C093`: metasprite `$52` (8 sprites).

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): the shaft: the first piece
regions.description: x := the body's x + dx (8 less for the right arm); y := the body's y + 24; the tile base `$87` := `$1E` + `$06C8`.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): the shaft: the loop
regions.description: While `$18` (the extension) is `$31` or more: a single sprite (`$C0DB` = `$CF05`), x += the step, y += 16, the extension -= 16. **A shaft of (extension - `$31`) / 16 + 1 pieces, 0-4.** RUN: extension 112 gave pieces at (162, 103), (166, 119), (170, 135), (174, 151) for a body at (190, 79); extension 48 gave none.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): an arm's hit test (`$84CA`)
regions.description: The object is moved by (A, Y), `JSR $C0B4` with A = `$52` sets the hit box of metasprite `$52`, `JSR $C0C9` tests it against the ship and the shots (carry = hit), and the position is put back.

regions.name: IT, the last boss (type `$4F`, bank 1 `$82B5`, slot `$800C`; corridor 22): an arm was hit
regions.description: `$6E` = the slot that hit it: a shot (non-zero) goes to `$C168` (`$FECC`) - **the shot is spent and the boss takes nothing**; the ship (0) goes to `$C0D8`, the boss rules, so touching an arm hurts the ship. RUN: shots on either arm vanished and left the boss's hit points at 124.
